reviews.text: My buddy Baxter, a mixed breed rescue, has finished his fight with Chronic Kidney Disease. I brought him to Mission Vet not eating, weak, and in a condition such that it might have been easiest to have him put to sleep immediately. Mission Vet managed to bring him back for two solid months of walks, gobbling up cicadas all through the summer and into September, and curling up in my lap in the evenings. Time enough for a proper good-bye, and time I might never have had with any other Veterinarians. The time was expensive. Veterinary care is a great bargain compared to uninsured human care, but that still puts it in a category where pet owners in situations like ours may have to make some really hard decisions about the relative value of a savings account versus a few more months with a good buddy. We are fortunate, and we could afford to give Baxter all the extra time he could get, but as with any intensive medical care, it wasn't easy. With that said, I cannot say enough good about the reception staff, veterinarians, and technicians at Mission Vet. They took great care of Baxter, got to know him and like him and he got to like them; they recognized me before I even made it through the front door when I came to visit; they responded quickly, carefully, and with compassion whenever I called for more support or advice. I've attached a photo of Baxter during his stay there, with his nasal feeding tube and the IV line that brought his creatinine levels back to where he could eat on his own for two more months. They were up-front about the costs and benefits of each procedure, diagnostic or corrective, and clear about the chances for good or adverse outcomes at every step. For serious health emergencies with our pets, Mission Vet has definitely earned our family's loyalty and if or when we have any similar problems with other pets, we will be returning here. Baxter is gone, but he could not have had better help with keeping him here as long as possible nor with easing his final departure, and I am very grateful indeed for that.

Our dog Moose had to undergo emergency abdominal surgery here due to a ruptured gallbladder, and we honestly could not have asked for a better team to care for our boy.

Dr. Lozano and Dr. Dalton (I believe his last name is Hidmarsh) were absolutely incredible, knowledgeable, and compassionate. The way they worked together as a team was extraordinary. Dr. Rose, who performed Moose’s surgery, was truly God-sent. She took the time to calm my husband’s and my nerves, answer every question we had, and make us feel reassured during one of the scariest moments of our lives.

The critical care technicians, Angie and Karina, were equally amazing. They were so kind, loving, and gentle with Moose. They consistently sent updates, called us, and did everything they could to keep us informed and comforted. Jasmine and Laura, who helped us on our first day, were also wonderful and made a difficult situation a little easier.

Before bringing Moose here, I read some of the reviews and became extremely worried. I am so grateful we trusted this team and gave them the opportunity to care for our boy. Every person we encountered showed compassion, professionalism, and genuine care for Moose and our family.

Yes, the cost of emergency veterinary care is expensive, but in our experience, the care Moose received was worth every penny. They helped save our boy’s life, and we will forever be grateful for that.

Please don’t let one negative review discourage you from giving this team a chance. Everyone’s experience is different, but ours was truly exceptional. Thank you to the entire team for taking such wonderful care of our Moose when we needed you most. ❤️🐾

When Jack Jack needed specialized veterinary care, the team at MissionVet Specialty & Emergency exceeded our expectations. Every doctor, technician, and staff member we interacted with was caring, attentive, and professional. They kept us updated, explained treatment options clearly, and showed genuine affection for Jack Jack throughout his stay.

A special thank you to Karina, who provided daily photo updates that meant so much to us and helped ease our worries while Jack Jack was hospitalized. We also want to recognize Jack's Critical Care team, especially Kristen, whose compassion, expertise, and dedication were truly incredible. Knowing he was surrounded by people who genuinely cared for him gave us so much comfort during a difficult time.

It's clear that this team truly loves animals and is deeply committed to providing exceptional care. We can't thank them enough for helping our sweet boy and would highly recommend MissionVet Specialty & Emergency to anyone in need of expert veterinary care. 🐾❤️
